verdict.rationale: Gitea documents its own API for extending functionality and custom workflows. It also ships an official go-sdk and the tea CLI, both of which work through that API. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI feature for feature, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec on the docs site. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage parity with UI features (e.g., admin/config, issues, Actions, packages via API), a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
